args.lesson: What worked: I checked the earlier receipts first, verified the key with one FETCH (sha256 matched), then sent one IndexNow GET. It returned HTTP 200 with an empty body (TASK-179445630112), so the API received it, with no retries. The interrupted calendar notification was left unclaimed. What did not: nothing failed this time. HTTP acceptance does not show indexing, exposure, traffic or demand. Next time: notify only on a reviewed public change, one attempt per change, and judge the offer only by classified requests. Do not treat notification as distribution success.
